title: Automotive Flex Funnel with Hose | Wide Mouth Flexible Oil Funnel for Automotive Use - Gas, Transmission Fluid, Car Fuel, Oil Change (Blue)
description:
About this item
WIDE MOUTH FUNNEL | Each funnel has a mouth that is 5.7” in diameter, so you can pour directly from large-mouth containers or buckets without worrying about spills.
STRONG PLASTIC CONSTRUCTION | Durable plastic funnels won't crack or shatter. Polyethylene funnel and hose resist corrosion from oil, diesel, gasoline, kerosene, and other small-engine fluids.
INCLUDED HOSE | Each funnel ends in a .6” threaded spout. Screw on the 9.8” flexible hose for easy, no-spill fluid transfers.
CONVENIENT HANDLE | Keep your hands away from slippery automotive fluids by gripping the handle on the side of the funnel.
BUILT TO LAST | Constructed from high-quality, durable materials, this gas funnel for car and automotive use withstands frequent use, resisting wear and tear while offering easy cleaning for extended product life.
reviews_5s:
Funnel works as advertizedGood quality for the price. I bought this for my new car, hoping I'll never need it !Well made, easy to use, leak proof, perfectly sized funnel. A great value!Flexible spout allows me to fill the coolant reservoir on my 2014 Ford Escape.PerfectWorks as neededWorked perfectly for what I needed it forWorks great though I wish the funnel part was bigger and the hose a little longer.This made putting gas into my car from a 5 gallon container very easy. Pretty sturdy!The Terbold Automotive Flex Funnel with Hose has been a fantastic addition to my DIY toolkit. I used it recently for an oil change and was pleased with how flexible and easy it was to maneuver. The wide mouth makes pouring oil into the engine a breeze, and the hose attachment helps reach those awkward spots without any spillage.

What I really like is the versatility of this funnel. It’s not just for oil changes; I’ve also used it for refilling transmission fluid and even topping off the gas tank on my lawnmower. The funnel material feels durable, and it hasn’t shown any signs of wear after multiple uses.

One minor thing to note is that the hose can sometimes be a bit stiff initially, but it loosens up with use and becomes more manageable. The blue color is a nice touch, making it easy to spot among my other tools.

For anyone who does their own vehicle maintenance, this funnel is a game-changer. It simplifies the process and helps avoid messy spills, making the whole experience much smoother.
